channel_scope.reason: The selected-hit-root locator is clean on total2 112-135 but is a false-positive on the known total3/4 120-127 non-preserving surface.

pre_factor_gate.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

primary_root_policy.name: prefactor_selected_hit_root_first_target_hash
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 136-143 from total2 112-135 diagnostics: 6/6 preserving, zero false positives, all scan/direct below rho, and mean evaluated root count 1.0
algorithm: read pre_factor_selected_hit_roots from the preregistered gate manifest
rank Sage root-hyperplane candidates whose root is in that set first
fall back to target_root_hash among candidates not in the pre-factor hit-root set
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane
charge all selector work plus root-scan or direct-root accounting

baseline_root_policies.name: target_root_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: previous preregistered total2 primary; preserving but too expensive on 128-135

baseline_root_policies.name: low_root_norm
baseline_root_policies.reason: posthoc static best on 128-135, still above rho

promotion_condition: After generating the 136-143 total2 strict signature and pre-factor manifest, factor only total2 gate-selected surfaces and score prefactor_selected_hit_root_first_target_hash. Count as a total2 scan-positive promotion only if all total2 gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and scan-below-rho. Count as a weaker total2 direct-root-positive result only if all total2 gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and direct-below-rho.
non_claims: This does not promote total3/4 surfaces.
This does not claim end-to-end ECDLP recovery faster than Pollard rho.
This does not claim the pre-factor hit-root locator is safe outside total2 without a separate discriminator.
